title: WHITEOUT: BELOW ZERO
description: WHITEOUT is a winter-focused Minecraft with infinity winter modpack that turns survival into a cold, atmospheric adventure. Expect stunning visuals, smooth QoL, immersive UI/animations, and a progression path packed with exploration and challenges.
body:
## WHITEOUT

**WHITEOUT** is a winter-themed Minecraft modpack built around atmosphere, immersion, and polished gameplay. Expect a colder, moodier survival experience with upgraded visuals, cleaner UI, and quality-of-life improvements that keep the game smooth without killing the challenge.

### What to expect
- **Winter vibe first:** snow, cold visuals, and a darker, cozy tone.
- **Immersion & polish:** animated details, improved UI/UX, and consistent aesthetics.
- **QoL upgrades:** smarter tweaks that reduce busywork and make progression feel better.
- **Adventure-driven gameplay:** exploration, danger.

### Recommended
For the best experience, use enough RAM (8-12 GB recommended) and keep your GPU drivers up to date.

### Support
Found a bug or balance issue? Please report it with logs and your mod list so it can be fixed faster.
